requirements: single monotonic event_seq with no gaps for all participating threads
timestamps in one monotonic ns clock domain
all measured frames plus pipeline fill and drain are present

safety_rules: decode the finalized submitted bytes and require exactly one last FINISH
resource death is no earlier than device_done, never host submit return by assumption
validate instruction and UOP used ranges before either copy or device launch

fail_closed_conditions: missing required field or unknown resource_id
event_seq gap, truncated trace, dropped event, or clock-domain ambiguity
physical overlap without an explicit legal alias relation
allocation without release/free semantics or access without matching begin/end
FINISH not decoded from the exact submitted instruction bytes
enabled replay without complete retained-resource and invalidation events
dynamic shape exceeds its recorded bound
failure_action: do not build the conflict graph and do not report naive-sum/per-queue-max/lifetime-packing savings as comparable results

lifetime_and_conflict_rules.birth: first alloc/bind/write that makes the resource generation live
lifetime_and_conflict_rules.conflict: two logical resources conflict when their closed-open live intervals overlap and they cannot legally alias the same physical byte range
lifetime_and_conflict_rules.death: last read/write completion, device_done, replay invalidation, or free, whichever is latest
packing_inputs: alias legality and physical pool bounds

minimum_collection.frames: warmup plus at least pipeline_depth + 2 measured frames and complete drain
instrumentation_points: vta/runtime/runtime.cc: command append/finalize, Synchronize, DeviceRun completion, capture/replay/invalidate
native pipeline runner: slot acquire/release and frame/stage/invocation correlation context
minimum_collection.scope: one frozen topology and manifest before expanding to A/B/C/D

purpose: construct and validate a unified data/control birth-death conflict graph

replay.disabled_policy_rule: when replay_policy=disabled, capture and replay APIs must reject before retaining or launching any template resource
